Package com.microservices.user.roles.services

Class RoleService

java.lang.Object
com.microservices.user.roles.services.RoleService
@Service public class RoleService extends Object
Service class responsible for managing roles in the system. This class provides methods to persist, delete, and retrieve roles. It handles interactions with the RoleRepository and manages role-related transactions.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Pouria Ghafarbeigi
